purpose: Scope review scenarios; not workflow wire fixtures or executed admission tests

cases.name: direct_apply
cases.input_intent: DeployWhisper executes terraform apply
cases.reason: Tier 2 execution is excluded

cases.name: direct_destroy
cases.input_intent: DeployWhisper destroys infrastructure
cases.reason: Tier 2 execution is excluded

cases.name: automatic_remediation
cases.input_intent: DeployWhisper fixes infrastructure automatically
cases.reason: Remediation is excluded

cases.name: unattended_approval
cases.input_intent: A timeout or agent approves a run
cases.reason: Only a verified authorized human may decide

cases.name: unattended_handoff
cases.input_intent: A workflow dispatches without a fresh matching human decision
cases.reason: Approval is mandatory on every handoff path

cases.name: arbitrary_script
cases.input_intent: A workflow supplies shell or command text
cases.reason: Closed step registry has no arbitrary script kind

cases.name: plugin
cases.input_intent: A workflow dynamically loads an external step plugin
cases.reason: Generalized plugins are excluded

cases.name: loop_or_expression
cases.input_intent: A workflow adds an unbounded loop or executable expression
cases.reason: Only bounded DAG and typed substitutions

cases.name: failure_finally_handoff
cases.input_intent: A generic finally or failed-gate branch dispatches
cases.reason: Failure handlers cannot bypass matched fresh gate/decision

cases.name: additional_collector
cases.input_intent: An automatic Ansible/kubectl/Helm/Git/Terragrunt/CloudFormation collector is selected
cases.reason: P0 automatic collection is OpenTofu/Terraform only; supported uploads remain usable

cases.name: additional_adapter
cases.input_intent: A Jenkins/GitLab/ITSM or arbitrary outbound webhook target is selected
cases.reason: P0 handoff is one registered qualified GitHub receiver

cases.name: schedule_or_drift
cases.input_intent: A native cron or drift-monitoring workflow is selected
cases.reason: Schedules/drift are deferred

cases.name: promotion_or_deployment_wave
cases.input_intent: Unit waves provision upstream infrastructure or promote environments
cases.reason: Declared waves order preflight collection/review only

cases.name: inferred_unit_graph
cases.input_intent: An AI or detector infers units/dependencies without human declaration
cases.reason: Only explicit confirmed unit maps in P0

cases.name: new_ai_subsystem
cases.input_intent: AI Composer/Mapper/Planner/Diagnostician/Package Advisor gets workflow privileges
cases.reason: No new AI subsystem; existing narrative remains downstream

cases.name: package_ledger
cases.input_intent: The release adds package ledger/registry governance
cases.reason: Package subsystem is deferred

cases.name: ha_postgres
cases.input_intent: Automation runs HA, multiple app instances or PostgreSQL
cases.reason: Only qualified singleton SQLite baseline

cases.name: alternate_runner
cases.input_intent: Collection uses macOS/Windows, a root task or an unqualified sandbox
cases.reason: Selected profile is qualified disposable non-root Linux

cases.name: dummy_tool_qualification
cases.input_intent: A dummy binary or fixed argv is offered as containment proof
cases.reason: Real pinned tool/provider execution is mandatory

cases.name: cloud_exact_plan_receiver
cases.input_intent: A cloud-hosted receiver reconstructs the approved binary plan
cases.reason: Exact plan requires verified protected original local bytes

cases.name: shared_folder_custody
cases.input_intent: A writable shared directory alone supplies custody
cases.reason: Separated identities and immutable descriptor-verified custody required

cases.name: upload_exact_plan
cases.input_intent: Uploaded redacted JSON is used to authorize apply
cases.reason: Upload-only advisory evidence cannot authorize exact-plan mutation

cases.name: replan_old_grant
cases.input_intent: Receiver replans under an existing grant
cases.reason: Changed plan needs new evidence/decision tuple

cases.name: header_admin
cases.input_intent: Caller claims admin through legacy role or actor headers
cases.reason: Server-verified identity and memberships are mandatory

cases.name: shared_self_approval
cases.input_intent: Shared-mode requester approves their own run
cases.reason: Separation of duties required in shared mode

cases.name: expired_or_changed_tuple
cases.input_intent: A grant uses expired evidence or changed target/payload/epoch
cases.reason: Exact tuple and shortest deadline must still match

cases.name: unknown_contract
cases.input_intent: A request uses an unknown version, enum or capability
cases.reason: No safety downgrade or unknown-state acceptance

cases.name: acceptance_as_success
cases.input_intent: Dispatch HTTP acceptance is presented as deployment success
cases.reason: Only verified terminal receiver outcome establishes success

cases.name: uncertain_unlock
cases.input_intent: Cancellation or lease expiry releases an unknown-operation target lock
cases.reason: Uncertain effects retain lock for reconciliation

cases.name: uploaded_advisory
cases.input_intent: Existing supported upload produces a scoped advisory report
cases.reason: Verified scope/intake; repository identity may be unavailable; no apply authority

cases.name: isolated_collection
cases.input_intent: Admitted immutable source is collected by the qualified pinned Linux profile
cases.reason: Authority, real containment and local custody evidence prerequisites remain open

cases.name: exact_external_handoff
cases.input_intent: A verified human approves the bound exact request to a qualified local-custody receiver
cases.reason: Live authority, immutable plan, durable grant and recovery gates must pass

cases.name: emergency_bypass
cases.input_intent: An operator overrides a hard safety floor with an emergency reason
cases.reason: No emergency bypass in P0; a reason cannot override missing or invalid evidence

cases.name: delegated_approval
cases.input_intent: A human delegates approval to another credential or automation
cases.reason: No delegated approval in P0; actual authorized human decision required
